description:
Immutable who-did-what on sensitive operations (orders, holds, refunds, settlement, RBAC changes); domain event stream into a local warehouse for analytics beyond operational reports.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Sensitive mutations produce audit entries with actor, before/after, timestamp
- Domain events stream to a queryable local store; sales funnel analysis possible
- Audit entries are append-only and exportable

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
